definition: Every feature-level item additionally stores the activation of its feature at each FP-active edited position in the FP state (amp_fp) and in the quantized state (amp_q), as lists of floats in the order of the edited positions (the same order as the rows of the edit). These are the inputs of the prespecified baseline A 'activation correlation' (the correlation or cosine of the two amplitude vectors across the edited positions, with a defined fallback when a context has fewer than two positions) and of the activation-drift quantities of H1; the existing amp_fp_mean and amp_q_mean are their means.
scope: feature-level run only (group-level items have no single feature activation); additive fields; no change of the Gram, the cells or the frozen spec.
status: written before any full-run output of the study exists; the code's spec and freeze.json are unchanged.
title: Per-item amplitude vectors for the activation-correlation baseline
why: Baseline A of the frozen spec lists 'activation correlation', which the mean amplitudes stored so far cannot give (a correlation needs the per-position values). The vectors are a few floats per item and cost nothing.
